description: Select non-worsening groups of straight spans only after choosing the complete fitted geometry, preserving shared cuts, symmetry and native SVG curves.

validation.note: The full suite passed at 9fdcda7. A subsequent test-only change removes a Node type dependency, retaining constructor, length and every scalar comparison; all 27 affected tests and type/lint checks were rerun. The served runtime is unchanged.

fixedReplay.method: The baseline is the saved final output, not a rerun of the old optimizer. Apply final degree reduction to the identical saved geometry with its original mask, weights, symmetry and matching constraints. No gradient updates, clamping, matching search or shared-cut search. Both outputs are validated and independently rendered from exported curves. Cleanup time excludes input loading and independent checks. Upstream fitter and validator sources must still match the reference.

hunodan.method: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

weighted.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

rejectedExperiments.reason: Star maximum cut distance plus sampling bound increased from 0.421 to 0.541 mm, failing the unchanged 0.5 mm published-template gate, despite lower pixel error.

rejectedExperiments.method: Selective proposal after each refinement stage
rejectedExperiments.reason: Later optimization received different starting geometry; hjfla-01 and hjcur-02 exceeded existing quality caps in the 22-design replay.

limits: Fixed-output replay uses an unlimited diagnostic cleanup deadline; production allocates at most 500 ms of remaining budget and can skip reductions. Synchronous validation cannot be preempted.
Adaptive source disagreement and independent antialiased SVG classification are distinct metrics; the report retains all independent increases. Neither is a proof of continuous equality.
The selector reduces handle curvature, not zigzag anchors or a wrong cut layout.
Fresh timed optimization can choose different checkpoints under machine load. This report distinguishes those runs from fixed-geometry comparisons.
Baseline timing comes from previous executions; this is not a paired randomized performance experiment.
